assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: Worth trying if you already run local AI (image generation, fine-tuning, long-prompt work) on a GeForce RTX 30 card under Linux, on a machine you can afford to reboot. Nothing for chat reply speed, quantized Ollama models or games.

assignments.name: cost
assignments.value: Free. GPL-2.0 kernel module, optional donations (README).

assignments.name: install
assignments.value: git clone, make install (sudo), add gpu_unlock.targets=all to the kernel command line, reboot. Linux only.
